args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 deployed to production (us-east, us-west, eu-west) began failing health checks with an 18% error rate. Per runbook, rolled back all regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Rollback completed and verified: service is healthy again in all regions with error rate down to 0.2%. Note: v2.3.1 and its staging precursor v2.3.1-rc were both unhealthy; v2.3.1 should not be redeployed without investigation and change-manager approval.
args.title: checkout-api v2.3.1 failed health checks; rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Diagnosed**: `checkout-api` v2.3.1 was unhealthy in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate following the latest deploy.
2. **Rolled back** all regions to **v2.3.0** — the most recent version with a healthy production release history.
3. **Verified**: service is now healthy in all regions, error rate dropped from 18% to 0.2%.
4. **Opened SEV2 incident** `INC-0001` (on-call paged), documenting the failure, the rollback, and a note that v2.3.1 was unhealthy even in staging (v2.3.1-rc) and shouldn't be redeployed without investigation.
